_style: Hand-drawn game illustration in the exact style of the reference images: crisp dark ink outlines, watercolor-gouache fill with light paper texture, muted palette, soft shadows; no photorealism, no 3D render, no gloss. This is a background for the document-reading screen of a point-and-click game: straight-on view, even soft light, the object fills the whole frame. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT anywhere: no letters, no numbers, no words, no fake scribbles, no ruled writing lines in the text area — the large text area must stay clean and empty, the game prints the text over it later. One small funny detail is allowed only near an edge, never in the text area.
paper_union: Straight-on top view of a single sheet that fills the entire frame edge to edge: the trade-union holiday voucher form from the reference image — pale cream paper with a pale green guilloche ornamental border running around all four edges and a small round pale-green emblem medallion at the top center (a stylized fountain, no letters). Everything inside the border is clean blank paper, no lines. Slight wear, one soft crease. Small funny detail: a tiny orange starfish clinging to the top-right corner of the border like a paperclip.
paper_hotel: Straight-on view of a single sheet that fills the entire frame: thick white hotel letterhead paper with a thin beige double-line frame near the edges and, at the top center, a small beige emblem of a stylized three-tier cascade fountain (no letters). Strips of yellowed adhesive tape at the four corners, as on the notice taped to the hotel room door in the reference. The whole area inside the frame is blank. Small funny detail: in the bottom-right corner a faint round wet ring left by a suction cup.
paper_laminated: Straight-on view of a laminated hotel card that fills the entire frame: a clear glossy plastic lamination margin with a soft highlight runs around the edges; inside, cream card stock with a thin beige frame and a small round beige cascade-fountain emblem at the top center (no letters); a punched hole with a short loop of twine in the top-left corner (the card hangs on the minibar handle, like in the reference). The inner area is blank. Small funny detail: a tiny air bubble trapped under the laminate shaped like a fish.
paper_regulation: Straight-on view of a metal regulation plate that fills the entire frame, like the one screwed to the reception counter in the reference: brushed light steel with soft reflections, a brass screw in each corner. A rectangular window is cut straight through the plate: horizontal, about 60% of the plate width and 13% of its height, centered horizontally, its top edge at 42% and bottom edge at 55% of the image height; through the window the dark varnished wood of the counter shows. The rest of the plate is smooth and completely blank, no engraving, no lines. Small funny detail: one tiny barnacle stuck on the bottom-left screw head.
paper_office: Straight-on view of a plain white office sheet filling the entire frame, like the form lying on the trolley in the reference: very thin grey printed outer frame line near the edges only, everything inside is blank white paper. Small funny detail: a paperclip bent into the shape of a little seahorse clipped on the top edge.
paper_soviet: Straight-on view of a single sheet filling the entire frame: thin yellowish typewriter paper from a Soviet sanatorium, like the memo lying on the archive desk in the reference; a faint violet carbon-copy smudge along the left edge, a small rust mark from an old staple in the top-left corner, soft fold lines. The rest is blank. Small funny detail: a faint ring stain from a glass of tea in the bottom-right corner.
paper_1908: Straight-on view of the 1908 instruction sheet under glass in its dark wooden frame, as on the cave wall in the reference: the narrow frame runs along the edges of the image, inside cream aged paper with a thin printed ornamental vignette border line and foxing spots, a faint diagonal glass reflection. The paper inside the vignette is completely blank. Small funny detail: a tiny snail on the top edge of the frame.
page_ledger: Top-down view of an old office ledger lying open, the two-page spread fills the entire frame: dark leather spine down the middle, two cream pages, a few ink blots near the margins, worn page corners, like the open journal on the stone desk in the reference. Both pages are completely blank: no ruled columns, no writing. Small funny detail: a strand of dried seaweed used as a bookmark ribbon hanging from the spine at the bottom.
paper_kuh: Straight-on view of a single sheet filling the entire frame: thick, slightly damp, water-resistant paper, warm cream with a faint grey-blue tint, like the notices pinned under the wet radiating seal in the reference; a wavy darker damp edge along the bottom and right sides as if it lay on wet stone, a blind-embossed colorless frame line near the edges. Blank inside. Small funny detail: two tiny round suction-cup marks in the top-left corner.
paper_note: Close-up of a scrap of water-resistant paper torn unevenly, one corner folded over, tied with rough twine to the neck of a clear glass bottle with a cork — the bottle neck comes in from the left edge of the frame; the scrap is large, centered, occupying about 75% of the frame, on a blurred dark wooden background. The paper is blank. Small funny detail: a tiny hermit crab peeking from behind the bottle neck.
tag_seal: Close-up of the seal tag from the reference: a large manila cardboard tag with a reinforced hole, threaded on twisted wire with a small lead seal, lying flat on wet white-and-turquoise tiles with puddles and reflections; the tag occupies about 70% of the frame, centered. Its face is blank. Small funny detail: a little water droplet shaped like a fish on a tile.
tag_exhibit: Close-up of the paper museum label from the reference: a cream card label with a thin beige border and a tiny beige cascade-fountain emblem in the top-left corner (no letters), stuck with strips of clear tape at its corners over a brass water-meter dial; the dial and brass casing show blurred around the label's edges; the label fills about 80% of the frame. Its face is blank. Small funny detail: one tape strip has a trapped tiny feather.
tray_porcelain: Close-up straight-on view of the surface of a white porcelain hotel serving tray filling the frame: a thin gold line along the rim visible near the top and right edges, the large flat white surface empty and clean for a stamp, a few croissant crumbs near the rim. Small funny detail: one crumb is shaped like a tiny seashell.
plate_brass: Close-up straight-on view of the brass inventory plate riveted to the old dark brass frame inside the room-service trolley, as in the reference: a horizontal rectangular brass plate with four screws in the corners, patina, soft scratches; the plate fills about 85% of the frame width; the dark brass frame shows around it. The plate face is smooth and blank. Small funny detail: a tiny cobweb in one corner of the frame.
plate_enamel: Close-up straight-on view of a white enamel sign with a dark blue rim band and four screws, small chips along the edges showing black metal, exactly like the enamel sign in the reference; the sign fills about 85% of the frame on a dark, softly blurred wall. The white field is blank. Small funny detail: a tiny sea anemone growing at one chip.
plaque_museum: Close-up straight-on view of the exhibit nameplate from the reference: a rectangular silvery metal plate with small brass screws at the ends, mounted on the dark wooden plinth of a museum vitrine; the plate fills about 80% of the frame width. Its face is blank. Small funny detail: a tiny thumbprint smudge on the polished plate edge.
panel_pictograms: Close-up straight-on view of the beige plastic panel of the shower foam dispenser, filling the frame, with screws in the corners, on turquoise tiles: on the LEFT side a vertical column of four square pictograms, one under another, drawn exactly like the four in the reference (a hand pressing a button; foam bubbles; a shower stream; a crossed-out cup with a growing cap of foam); to the right of the column a large blank empty field. A faint round wet ring on the last pictogram. No letters or numbers. Small funny detail: a soap bubble stuck to the top edge.
panel_steel: Close-up straight-on view of the green-painted steel plate from above the lift gate in the reference: dark green paint with a thin brass edging and rivets, paint drips and rust streaks running down, it fills the entire frame. The green field is blank, no stencil. Small funny detail: a tiny spider hanging from a rivet.
panel_post: Close-up straight-on view of the brass lift call post from the reference, filling most of the frame on the beige wall above the turquoise tiles: vertical brass plate with screws, an amber lamp glowing at the top, two black buttons in white porcelain cups, and to the right of each button a small blank white enamel label plate. No letters. Small funny detail: a tiny wad of chewing gum stuck under the lower button cup.
box_switch: Close-up straight-on view of the grey metal switch box on the wooden wall of the old lift cabin, as in the reference: the box fills most of the frame, a black lever handle on its right side, a small lightning-bolt symbol in the top-left corner; the large flat front of the box is blank except for faint smudged traces of erased white chalk (no letters). Small funny detail: a stub of white chalk resting on the box's top edge.
label_sticker: Close-up straight-on view of a cream-white vinyl sticker with a thin gold border, stuck on mirror glass, as in the reference; one corner peels up; soft glass reflections around it and a piece of the gilded mirror frame in the bottom-right corner; the sticker fills about 75% of the frame. Its face is blank. Small funny detail: a reflection of a rubber duck in the glass at the edge.
label_can: Close-up straight-on view of a paper label wrapped around a metal can of interior paint, filling the frame: cream label with a beige color-swatch stripe along the top, beige paint drips running over the label edge from the rim, the can's metal ribs at the left and right edges. The label field is blank. Small funny detail: a beige-painted fingerprint of a starfish on the rim.
card_tent: Close-up straight-on view of the card in its brass frame holder on top of the brass water stand from the reference: a cream card in a brass frame, the brass stanchion top visible below, blurred mosaic floor behind; the card fills about 80% of the frame. The card is blank. Small funny detail: a single water droplet hanging from the bottom edge of the frame.
card_postcard: Straight-on view of the back side of an old Soviet postcard filling the entire frame, inside a cellophane sleeve with soft glare: cream card; on the right half a dotted rectangle for the stamp in the top-right corner and four thin ruled address lines; a thin vertical divider line in the middle; the left half is blank for the message. No letters, no numbers. Small funny detail: a tiny starfish-shaped water stain in the bottom-left corner.
token_big: Close-up top view of a large brass token lying on green baize, as in the reference: round, with a raised rim and a punched hole near the edge, a smooth blank face with soft patina; the token fills about 80% of the frame height, centered. No letters. Small funny detail: a tiny grain of sand stuck to the baize.
photo_thursday: An old albumen photograph print filling the entire frame, sepia tones, with a white paper margin around the image and a wider blank white margin at the bottom for a caption. The photo shows: a brass room-service trolley like in the references (old brass frame, cloth skirt with three pockets and heavy fringe, four brass stars along the front edge) standing beside the lattice scissor gate of an old lift, on a mosaic floor with a wave border; on the trolley top a bottle and a thick journal; no people. Small funny detail: a blurry seagull in the background as if it moved during the exposure.
photo_family: An old family photograph in a worn cardboard passe-partout mount filling the entire frame: in the window of the mount a sepia classic formal studio portrait exactly like the reference — Cthulhu as a dignified grandfather: octopus head with a beard of tentacles, folded webbed wings, sitting upright on a carved stone pedestal, sunken ruins in the background. Below the photo window the mount has a wide blank area for a caption. Small funny detail: a tiny pressed seaweed leaf tucked in the corner of the mount.
paper_lightbox: Top-down straight-on view of a milky frosted glass panel lit evenly from below, softly glowing, filling the entire frame, with brass corner brackets at the four corners like the glass panel in the floor in the reference; the glass surface is clean and empty. Small funny detail: a faint wet footprint of a slipper in one corner.
